verdict.rationale: Greenhouse ships built-in AI features such as Voice AI, Notetaker and Talent Matching, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is a fair question. The evidence pack never shows a way to connect external MCP servers so its AI can use their tools. The REST APIs, partner APIs and webhooks are integration surfaces other systems call into, not MCP client support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
